title: Influencer Marketing Agency in Colombia - AWISEE.com

facts.fact: DataReportal reports 37.7M social media users in Colombia, equal to 70.4% of the population.
facts.quote: social media users in Colombia, 70.4% of the population.

facts.fact: DataReportal reports TikTok ad reach in Colombia at 37.7M, equal to 93% of adults, using late-2025 data.
facts.quote: ad reach, 93% of adults in Colombia.

facts.fact: DataReportal reports Facebook ad reach in Colombia at 36.4M, equal to 67.9% of the population, using late-2025 data.
DataReportal reports YouTube ad reach in Colombia at 31.0M, equal to 57.9% of the population, using late-2025 data.
DataReportal reports Instagram ad reach in Colombia at 21.6M, equal to 40.2% of the population, using late-2025 data.
An IAB estimate cited by Forbes Colombia puts the number of content creators in Colombia at 650,000.
facts.quote: content creators in Colombia, by an IAB estimate.

facts.fact: In an Ipsos survey cited by Portafolio, TikTok was the favourite platform for watching creators at 29%, ahead of Instagram and YouTube at 25% each.
facts.quote: TikTok was the favourite platform for watching creators (29%), ahead of Instagram and YouTube (25% each).

facts.fact: According to the Medellín city government, a tourism campaign with six Colombian creators drew 30M+ early views across Latin America.
facts.quote: Medellín’s tourism campaign with six Colombian creators drew 30M+ early views across Latin America.

facts.fact: The Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) 2020 guide asks influencers to label paid content as advertising, in Spanish and as visible as the main message; the guide is non-binding guidance based on the consumer statute.
facts.quote: The SIC’s 2020 guide asks influencers to label paid content as advertising, in Spanish and as visible as the main message.

facts.fact: In 2023 the SIC opened investigations into companies linked to influencers, including over undisclosed commercial ties.
facts.quote: In 2023 the SIC opened investigations into companies linked to influencers, including over undisclosed commercial ties.

facts.fact: A Senate bill on content creators in Colombia would require labels such as 'Publicidad'; it passed its first debate in 2025 and is still pending.
facts.quote: A Senate bill on content creators would require labels such as “Publicidad”. It passed its first debate in 2025 and is still pending.

facts.fact: AWISEE's vendor offer states it sends ten matched creators within 48 hours at no charge after a brief request.
facts.quote: We send ten matched creators within 48 hours, free.
